info.title: Finance Aggregator API
info.summary: Backend API for traceable personal finance aggregation.
info.description: Local backend for manually managed portfolios and traceable financial imports. Exact decimal values are JSON strings. Import data affects the ledger only after explicit confirmation.

get.summary: Check whether the API process is alive
get.description: Returns success when the API process can serve requests; no database check is made.

get.summary: Check whether the API can reach PostgreSQL
get.description: Runs a minimal PostgreSQL query and returns 503 when the database is unavailable.

post.description: Creates the top-level reporting container and its base currency.

get.description: Returns a bounded page of portfolios ordered by creation time and ID.
Returns one portfolio without expanding its accounts or calculated positions.

delete.summary: Delete a portfolio and its accounts

post.description: Validates every instrument and exact append-only observation before one database commit. If any item is invalid or conflicts, no item from the batch is stored.

404.description: Referenced instrument was not found

get.summary: Resolve a market price at a valuation instant
get.description: Selects the latest append-only observation with observed_at not later than valuation_as_of. A future observation is never used; missing and stale states are returned explicitly with the selected observation age.

404.description: Referenced instrument was not found

post.summary: Record an exact manual market price
post.description: Stores a versioned positive price observation. Price is an exact decimal JSON string; existing observations are not overwritten.

404.description: Referenced instrument was not found

get.description: Returns price observations with optional instrument and inclusive observation-time filters, ordered newest first.

get.summary: Read the latest background crypto-price synchronization
get.description: Returns only safe status and counts, without market payloads or portfolio data.

schema.title: Response Latest Market Sync Route Api V1 Market Data Sync Latest Get

post.summary: Record an atomic batch of manual FX rates
post.description: Stores exact append-only fallback rates in one transaction. Rates use the convention one unit of base_currency equals rate units of quote_currency. A rejected item leaves the entire batch unchanged.

get.description: Lists append-only automatic and manual observations, newest first. Filters use the stored base/quote orientation and inclusive observation times.

get.summary: Resolve an FX rate at a valuation instant
get.description: Selects only observations at or before valuation_as_of. Resolution is limited to identity, direct, inverse, or one RUB pivot; it never searches an arbitrary graph or substitutes one for a missing cross-currency rate.

get.summary: Get the latest public FX synchronization job
get.description: Returns the latest scheduled or manual job, including after browser reload.

schema.title: Response Latest Fx Sync Route Api V1 Fx Rates Sync Get

post.summary: Queue a public USD/RUB FX synchronization
post.description: Queues a rate-limited PostgreSQL worker job. This request performs no external network I/O and sends no portfolio, account, import, or user data to the provider.

get.description: Returns queue state and a stable safe error code, without an external response body or financial values.

404.description: FX synchronization job was not found

post.summary: Recalculate and replace the portfolio position snapshot
post.description: Replays immutable ledger operations through the requested instant, selects eligible manual prices, and atomically replaces the derived snapshot. The ledger is unchanged.

post.summary: Upload an import file into traceable staging
post.description: Streams one or more CSV files, or one XLSX, XML, or PDF, into protected storage and queues parsing. XML is validated with DTD/entity prohibitions and bounded depth, element count, and value length. A repeated SHA-256 for the same account returns the existing batch with HTTP 200 and duplicate=true.

200.description: The same file was already uploaded to this account

413.description: The uploaded file exceeds the configured size limit

415.description: The file media type is not allowed

404.description: Import batch or referenced account was not found
